definitions.ask: How should the stale root-owned codex and claude installs under /usr/local be fixed?
definitions.why: One install per CLI removes the PATH-order hazard instead of resetting the drift clock

choices.label: Delete the stale /usr/local copies; nvm installs become the only copies and cannot drift
Upgrade the /usr/local copies in place; two installs per CLI can drift again later

definitions.ask: Should SASE detect shadowed agent CLI installs and name the binary when Codex rejects its version?
definitions.why: Shell and agent runners resolve different binaries, so tooling said current while agents ran stale

choices.label: Report skew in agent-cli list and doctor, plus an actionable Codex version-rejection error
Fix only the machine and file a task bead; the failure can silently recur after updates
